decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of cards centered around Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate a winning advantage. It utilizes cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Traverse the Ulvenwald to find key pieces while disrupting the opponent with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes removal options like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Witherbloom Command to control the board. Overall, the strategy involves assembling the combo pieces efficiently and protecting them to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies to create value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar work in tandem with Witch's Oven to deal damage and gain advantage. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing key creatures from the opponent, while Fatal Push provides removal. The deck also includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, for additional flexibility. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this Rakdos Sacrifice deck aims to pressure the opponent while controlling the battlefield.

This deck focuses on using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing players to cast powerful spells such as Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck includes cards like Sylvan Scrying and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to help find and untap Lotus Field, as well as cards like Hidden Strings and Dark Petition to search for key combo pieces. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game by casting high-impact spells and overwhelming the opponent with powerful card advantage and board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with green devotion creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. It also takes advantage of Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opposing artifacts and utilize sideboard cards like Boseiju, Who Endures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and utilize cards like Storm the Festival to refill the board with threats. The deck also includes Cityscape Leveler as a win condition and Lair of the Hydra for additional creature support.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using cheap, efficient creatures in combination with anthem effects to pump up the team. The goal is to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure early on, leveraging cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to disrupt the opponent's game plan and push for a swift victory. The inclusion of protection and evasion spells further enhances the deck's ability to close out games efficiently.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by sacrificing creatures for value and overwhelming the opponent with constant threats. It utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven to create a powerful engine that deals damage while disrupting the opponent's game plan. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and ensure the opponent can't stabilize. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game, using sacrifice synergies and efficient creatures to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly swarming the field with low-cost, efficient creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down the opponent's spells and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to boost the power of the weenie creatures, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. Cards like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional ways to generate creatures, while Ossification helps protect key creatures from removal spells. The goal is to maintain aggression and tempo throughout the game to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures and using combat tricks like Reckless Bushwhacker and Resolute Reinforcements to overwhelm opponents. It also utilizes powerful anthem effects like Venerated Loxodon and Clarion Spirit to buff the team. Den of the Bugbear provides additional aggression, while Giant Killer offers removal for threats. The use of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion ensures that the deck is always able to cast its creatures, maintaining the aggressive tempo. Overall, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently to win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with the help of mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to play big green creatures and powerful planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator. The deck utilizes green devotion to enable powerful spells and abilities that become stronger with more green mana symbols on the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Cavalier of Thorns help maintain card advantage and pressure opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Lotus Field and Thespian's Stage, while setting up combos with Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. The deck aims to cast big spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to overwhelm opponents. It also includes cards like Dark Petition and Mastermind's Acquisition for more combo potential and card selection. The deck utilizes a mix of land ramp, card draw, and tutor effects to create powerful and explosive plays to win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then use Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate a large amount of green mana. The deck utilizes green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to take advantage of this mana production. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and selection. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive creatures and powerful spells, ultimately dominating the board and securing victory.

The main idea of this deck is to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy using powerful enchantments like Fires of Invention and Enigmatic Incarnation. By utilizing a mix of creatures, including Keruga, the Macrosage, and various spells, you can manipulate the game state in your favor while setting up for big plays with cards like Agent of Treachery and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown also adds to the control aspect of the deck, making it difficult for opponents to execute their game plan effectively.
